summary: A hazard review specifies a remote isolation valve upstream of a transfer line. It is engineered, costed and scheduled into a capital plan, then deferred across three budget cycles. The plan exists; practice does not track it.

signal_basis.prior_report: searched: the review is a design document, not a report of an observed hazard
signal_basis.figure_without_clock: searched: the cost estimate is re-run each cycle and carries its own date
signal_basis.designed_control: engineered, costed, scheduled, three deferrals on the record
signal_basis.no_instrument: the line is instrumented for pressure and flow

authoring_note: Built so the recursion fires: the remedy for a control conceived and not built is itself closed unimplemented.

plan.why: engineered, costed and scheduled into a capital plan; deferred across three budget cycles. The deferrals are on the record, so practice not tracking the plan is documented rather than inferred.
